portfolios.title: AGE – Decode Worlds
portfolios.content: Our Engineering Portfolio for Cerberon documents our journey through the Decode season up to the World Championship. We focused on building a robust, modular chassis and a highly efficient intake system. Key highlights include our autonomous path planning algorithms and custom 3D printed mechanisms.

portfolios.title: DIVE – Into The Deep
portfolios.content: The DIVE portfolio covers the development of HILDA. This season challenged us to design a submersible intake arm. We documented our iterative design process, from early cardboard prototypes to the final carbon-fiber assembly.

portfolios.title: SHOW – Centerstage
portfolios.content: Our first comprehensive engineering portfolio. SHOW details the coordinate-based movement system of our robot X, along with our team outreach initiatives and strategic game analysis.
